scope: NEW helper files only; existing tasks, graders, rubric, pilot runner and historical reviews unchanged

validation.command: .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q heldout7/_shared/test_automated_judge.py -k 'pinned_configuration or uncertainty or strict_judge_booleans or complete_caveat'
validation.v1_transport_live_validation: Root reported first/only v1 native call closed with valid schema and zero tool calls.

transport.transport: existing CodexSession and Container; one fresh turn; read-only sandbox; no candidate mounts; shell_tool/code_mode/multi_agent disabled; reject tool events
transport.tool_gate_note: Existing CLI reports shell_tool=false, code_mode=false and multi_agent=false under explicit disables. unified_exec remains true despite disable, so no claim it is disabled; shell_tool is the command-tool gate. The single v1-reviewed-fixes native call completed with valid schema and no tool events, as recorded by the root. No v2 inference has yet run.
transport.scoring: Comparison only for historical pilot; preserve formal status and separate caveat/uncertainty observations. Future publishing supplies existing private semantic channel, never fabricates human review.
transport.abstention_policy: Any nonempty unverified_claims or evidence_limitations forces nonfinal, nonpublishable, inconclusive retained judgment.

launch_steps: Prepare a bounded explicit selections JSON for each closed record. Include public task sources, author proof, selected snapshot text and bound closed executed-command outputs as needed; do not include author verdicts or candidate reasoning.
Run .venv/bin/python heldout7/_shared/automated_judge.py prepare CLOSED_RUN SELECTIONS_JSON NEW_PREPARED_DIR
Compare with preserved bound author semantic input using compare ATTEMPT_DIR REFERENCE_SEMANTIC_JSON. Do not publish historical pilot reviews.
important_limitations: shell_tool/code_mode/multi_agent disables verified with installed native feature listing. unified_exec remains true despite disable; shell_tool is the execution-tool gate, no claim unified_exec disabled.
Model semantic judgment is not deterministic proof. Missing command evidence is explicit uncertainty, not automatic false claims.
Complete-status caveats are retained descriptively; formal outcome metrics remain unchanged.

Publisher protects pilot* attempts and existing reviews, creates a pending-grade preservation copy, and never runs candidate code or regrades. Existing grader requires legacy provenance string; explicit metadata says automated, not human-reviewed.
Prepared evaluator pin is checked before native run; changing helpers/config after preparation invalidates prepared artifacts.
Paths with symlinked components are rejected; use canonical /private/tmp rather than /tmp for prepared/attempt directories on macOS.
Uncertainty abstains instead of assigning an unsupported false claim or a final score.

Only the first v1 comparison ran; its generic uncertainty caused abstention. The four others were withheld. v2 clarifies material uncertainty without candidate-specific facts or changing fail-closed host logic.
remaining: Readiness review then root runs the five fixed v2 comparisons; use new prepared-v2 and attempt-v2-1 paths, never overwrite existing v1 prepared/attempt evidence. Six total planned judge calls across versions: one retained v1 and five v2. Do not pool versions.
review_fixes: Any nonempty uncertainty list forces final=false, abstained=true, publishable=false; comparison is inconclusive and publication rejects before any writes.
CodexSession exclusively owns container start/close; helper duplicate lifecycle calls removed.
Strict per-task proof allowlist rejects solutions/reference verdicts/history.
Proposed rubric/status/reviewer identity validated against packet and fixed configuration.
headless.py and container.py pinned by hash; headless content never read.

version_policy.reason: The sole v1 comparison returned all three decisions true but listed a generic lack-of-execution-log caveat despite no execution claim. The host correctly abstained. v2 clarifies that uncertainty fields are only for material unresolved claims/evidence preventing a rubric decision.
version_policy.withheld_reason: Known generic-uncertainty interpretation failure; no calls were made for the remaining four v1 comparisons.
version_policy.comparison_composition: Four closed natural responses plus one synthetic no-code positive control; the synthetic control is excluded from model-calibration counts.
version_policy.reporting_policy: Retain the v1 result as an evaluator-validation outcome. Report all five v2 comparisons under their own fixed configuration; do not pool versions, replace the prior attempt, or call the additional v2 comparison a candidate rerun.
version_policy.source_boundary: No unlisted harness source read; no model calls by this agent.
